text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Russian ultra-nationalist leader Zhirinovesky leads a picket in front of the American embassy in Moscow protesting against the recent U.S. missile attack against Iraq.
- Russian ambassador at the U.N. says work is in progress to implement the oil-for-food deal Iraq signed with the world body.
- Iraq and Vietnam start trade talks in Baghdad.
- Iraq sets up a national committee to search for Kuwaitis and Iraqis missing in action.
- Vietnam opens trade centre in Baghdad.
- Baghdad still supplies the northern provinces with oil products.
